home.title: Writing
home.subtitle: Pick a DSE-style task, plan with AI scaffolding, write it yourself, then get detailed feedback.

generate.title: Get a task
generate.description: We first serve a task from the shared bank that you haven't seen. If none fits, a new one is written for you.
generate.subject: Subject
generate.costNote: Free from the bank; {cost} credits if a new task has to be written.
generate.descriptionLocal: The AI writes a new DSE-style task for you. It's saved on this device.

bank.title: Browse the question bank
bank.description: Search every checked writing task by genre, text type, part or keyword. Browsing is free.
bank.descriptionLocal: Browse the writing tasks saved on this device.

own.title: My own question
own.description: Paste a prompt from your teacher or a past exercise. It stays private to you.
own.taskTitlePlaceholder: e.g. A letter to the principal about the school canteen
own.materialsPlaceholder: Reading materials for 甲部 / Part A, if any…
own.privateNote: Answers to your own questions can't be made public, because the question is private.
own.descriptionLocal: Paste a prompt from your teacher or a past exercise. It's saved on this device.

recent.title: Recent writing
recent.empty: Nothing yet. Pick a task to start.

helpers.title: Ask AI before you write
helpers.scaffoldingOnly: Scaffolding only — notes, words and patterns. Write the essay yourself.
helpers.failed: The AI couldn't help just now. Your credits were refunded.
helpers.cachedNote: Answers are saved for this task, so opening them again is free.

about.task_analysis: What the task really asks: text type, audience, purpose, tone, traps and what to prepare.
about.outline: A paragraph plan with brief point notes for each paragraph.
about.vocabulary: Topic vocabulary grouped by theme, with synonyms and usage notes.
about.sentence_patterns: Sentence patterns that suit this task, each with one short example.
about.idioms: Idioms or 成語 that fit the topic, with meaning, usage and a short example.

helpers.failedLocal: The AI couldn't help just now. Please try again.
helpers.cachedNoteLocal: Answers are saved on this device for this task, so opening them again is instant.

editor.title: Write your answer
editor.description: Type it here, or upload photos of your handwriting.
editor.photoHelp: Take clear, flat photos in page order. We copy your handwriting exactly — including mistakes — so the feedback is fair.
editor.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

review.descriptionPhoto: Compare with your pages and fix anything we misread. Every change is tracked and shown with your feedback.
review.descriptionTyped: Make any last changes before you submit.
review.markerHelp: [X?] = we weren't sure; [X!] = the character looks malformed; {+…+} = words you inserted. Fix or keep them — the brackets are removed when you submit.
review.submitDescription: Feedback covers whether you met the task, strengths, errors and upgrades tied to your own sentences.
review.estimateHelp: Marks per criterion and an estimated level, calibrated on HKEAA exemplars. It's an estimate, not an official grade.
review.noEstimatePartA: 甲部 gets feedback only — DSE estimates aren't available for practical writing yet.

progress.transcribingHelp: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page; we'll keep working.
progress.gradingHelp: This usually takes one to two minutes.
progress.transcribeFailedHelp: Your credits were refunded. You can try again, or type your answer instead.
progress.transcribingHelpLocal: This usually takes under a minute. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
progress.gradingHelpLocal: This usually takes one to two minutes. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
progress.transcribeFailedHelpLocal: Reading failed or was interrupted. You can try again, or type your answer instead.

feedback.notLocated: Couldn't find this exact text in your writing.

next.title: What next?
next.sampleHelp: See your own essay rewritten at a higher level — same ideas and plan — with a note on every change.

estimate.title: DSE estimate
estimate.disclaimer: An AI estimate calibrated on HKEAA exemplars. Your teacher's grade always takes priority.

sample.title: Level sample
sample.description: Your essay upgraded, keeping your ideas, examples and plan. Hover or tap a highlight to see why it changed.
sample.defaultFromEstimate: Suggested: Level {level}, one above your estimate.
sample.defaultNoEstimate: Suggested: Level 4 (you didn't ask for an estimate).
